items.definition: Guard is a keyword ability. While you control a unit with Guard, an attacking unit must be blocked by a unit with Guard before any unit without Guard may block.
items.short_definition: Must be blocked before units without Guard.

items.definition: Swift is a keyword ability. A card with Swift may be played at any time a player holds priority, including during the opponent's turn.
items.short_definition: May be played whenever you hold priority.

items.definition: Bolster N is a keyword ability. When this unit enters play, put N +1/+1 counters on target unit you control.
items.short_definition: Adds counters to a unit you control on entry.

items.definition: Fade N is a keyword ability. This card enters play with N time counters. Remove one at the start of your turn. When the last is removed, discard this card.
items.short_definition: Leaves play after N of your turns.

items.definition: Resolve is a unit's printed toughness. A unit with damage marked on it equal to or greater than its Resolve is destroyed.
items.short_definition: How much damage a unit survives.

items.definition: Strength is a unit's printed attack value. A unit deals damage equal to its Strength in combat.
items.short_definition: How much damage a unit deals.
